caption: The Course Builder in the free plugin: our course opened with one section and three lessons, and we wrote the third one.
Access plan types in the core plugin: free, monthly, annual, one time, lifetime, paid trial and more. Gift purchases, group access and name your price are add ons.
The course page with our free access plan and its Enroll Now button.
Even for the free plan, the default checkout asked for an address, city, state and ZIP code. We used made up values.
After enrolling we marked our lesson complete; the course progress moved to 33.33%.
Pricing on 22 Nov 2026 in the November sale: Earth at $159.20 for the first year for one site, normally $398; the core plugin is free.
